verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred stack intact: the logo is a readable size, the one-line headline is clearly dominant, and the CTA and fine print sit in the right order. Its flaws are small: the card's bottom edge is close to the canvas edge and the book nearly touches the card. B shrinks the Inkwell & Lantern logo to an unreadable smudge in the top-left corner and crams the body copy, CTA and tiny 3-line legal text into one cramped row. That breaks the reading order, buries the CTA and leaves dead space at the bottom of the card.
